title: Saving message history to disk and trimming the context window
description: ModelMessagesTypeAdapter loads and saves the full message list as JSON on disk, while ProcessHistory(keep_recent) sends only the most recent slice to the model.

steps.description: keep_recent slices the last six messages and drops any leading messages that are not a ModelRequest so the trimmed history always begins with a request.
Attach ProcessHistory(keep_recent) to the agent and load any existing messages from history.json using ModelMessagesTypeAdapter.validate_json.
Pass message_history=history into agent.run_sync, print the reply, and write result.all_messages() back to history.json.
